chain.title: Begin the Gravekeeper's Craft
chain.desc: Gather Grave's Dust through the mod's available drops. Open its in-game Compendium for your version's mechanics.

chain.title: A Spark for the Grave
chain.desc: Obtain Essence of Undeath through the mod's progression or available rewards. Inspect the Compendium's introductory instructions.

chain.title: A Place for Wandering Souls
chain.desc: Craft and place a Decorative Grave. It can become haunted over time; a placed grave does not guarantee an immediate soul.

chain.title: Wait for a Soul
chain.desc: Observe a soul haunting your Decorative Grave. Confirm when it appears, rather than assuming crafting the grave completed this event.

chain.title: Know the Way Back
chain.desc: Read the Compendium's grave recovery instructions and locate its recovery controls. Confirm when you know how to find and unlock a future grave; this task requires no death.

chain.title: Put a Haunting to Use
chain.desc: Use an available enchanted-item or key interaction with the haunting soul as described in the Compendium. Confirm after the interaction succeeds.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: A focused recovery and grave-magic introduction without forcing intentional death or random rare loot.
coverage.limitations: Official author documentation reviewed; no matching local JAR was available. Rare random loot, destructive reset items and an obligation to die are excluded from the main progression.
coverage.verification_detail: Existing 1.20.1 item names retained conservatively; installed item and task availability must be checked by the runtime scanner.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
verified_against: Official documentation; no matching local JAR reverified in this audit
